pages.about.headline: Donor–hospital coordination
pages.about.lead: Hospitals create blood requests. Compatible donors receive invitations in parallel. There is no public blood search.
pages.about.step1.title: Hospital request
pages.about.step1.body: Verified staff record blood type, units, urgency, and a needed-before time.
pages.about.step2.title: Parallel matching
pages.about.step2.body: BloodLink invites several suitable donors at once. One response never blocks the others.
pages.about.step3.title: Donor decision
pages.about.step3.body: A donor may accept or decline. Acceptance is willingness to be contacted, not a donation.
pages.about.step4.title: Hospital confirmation
pages.about.step4.body: Only the hospital marks a request fulfilled after the real care process.
pages.contact.headline: Contact BloodLink
pages.contact.thanks: Thank you. We will get back to you shortly.
pages.privacy.headline: Privacy notice
pages.privacy.lead: BloodLink collects only the information needed to coordinate blood requests between hospitals and donors. It is not a medical diagnosis service.
pages.privacy.collected.title: Information collected
pages.privacy.collected.body: Name, CIN, phone, email, city, blood type, role, request details, and messages you send in the app.
pages.privacy.usage.title: Usage
pages.privacy.usage.body: To match donors with hospital blood requests and to send related notifications.
pages.privacy.donor.title: Donor data
pages.privacy.donor.body: Shown in anonymized form (donor IDs) whenever possible. Availability is used only for matching.
pages.privacy.hospital.title: Hospital data
pages.privacy.hospital.body: Hospital name, city, contact, verification status, and request history.
pages.privacy.emergency.title: Emergency requests
pages.privacy.emergency.body: Treated as sensitive coordination data and circulated only through verified hospital accounts.
pages.privacy.sharing.title: Sharing
pages.privacy.sharing.body: Request details are shared only with matched donors and authorized hospital staff.
pages.privacy.retention.title: Retention
pages.privacy.retention.body: Account and request records remain until you delete them or close the account.
pages.privacy.rights.title: User rights
pages.privacy.rights.body: You may access, correct, or request deletion of your data under Moroccan Law 09-08.
pages.privacy.consent.title: Consent
pages.privacy.consent.body: Registration and the safety screen record your consent to coordination.
pages.privacy.contact.title: Contact
pages.privacy.contact.body: Use the Contact page for privacy questions.
pages.safety.headline: Safety and responsibility
pages.safety.notMedical.title: Not a medical service
pages.safety.notMedical.body: BloodLink does not replace doctors, hospitals, or transfusion services.
pages.safety.eligibility.title: Eligibility
pages.safety.eligibility.body: Eligibility must be medically confirmed by authorized professionals. In-app screening is preliminary only.
pages.safety.verified.title: Verified requests
pages.safety.verified.body: Hospital and staff users are responsible for verifying a real clinical need before a request is circulated.
pages.safety.duty.title: Hospital / staff duty
pages.safety.duty.body: Coordination support never transfers clinical responsibility away from the care site.
pages.safety.privacy.title: Privacy
pages.safety.privacy.body: Donor identities stay limited. Hospitals see only the information needed to coordinate a request.
pages.safety.location.title: Location
pages.safety.location.body: Approximate city is used unless a donor explicitly allows browser geolocation. Exact coordinates are never shown.
pages.safety.consentLead: I understand BloodLink is a coordination service and not a medical diagnosis or emergency service.
pages.safety.requestVerificationValue: Staff confirm clinical need, blood type, and units
